mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc3_entity_state (id, entity_type_flag, entity_id, parent_entity_id, entity_state_flag, last_state_flag, lease_version, expire_time, timeout_seconds, last_heartbeat_time, last_alarm_id, timeout_source_flag, entity_state_ext, tenant_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{entityTypeFlag}, #{entityId}, #{parentEntityId}, #{stateFlag}, #{initialLastStateFlag}, 1, #{expireTime}, #{timeoutSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, #{timeoutSourceFlag}, json_build_object('type', #{stateExtType}::text, 'content', COALESCE(#{stateDescription}::text, ''), 'version', 1), #{tenantId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, entity_type_flag, entity_id) DO UPDATE SET parent_entity_id = EXCLUDED.parent_entity_id, entity_state_flag = EXCLUDED.entity_state_flag, last_state_flag = dc3_entity_state.entity_state_flag, lease_version = dc3_entity_state.lease_version + 1, expire_time = EXCLUDED.expire_time, timeout_seconds = EXCLUDED.timeout_seconds, last_heartbeat_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, timeout_source_flag = EXCLUDED.timeout_source_flag, entity_state_ext = CASE WHEN COALESCE (#{stateDescription}:: text, '') != '' THEN json_build_object( 'type', dc3_entity_state.entity_state_ext->>'type', 'content', #{stateDescription}:: text, 'version', COALESCE ((dc3_entity_state.entity_state_ext->>'version'):: int, 0) + 1 ) ELSE dc3_entity_state.entity_state_ext END, operate_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO dc3_entity_state (id, entity_type_flag, entity_id, parent_entity_id, entity_state_flag, last_state_flag, lease_version, expire_time, timeout_seconds, last_heartbeat_time, last_alarm_id, timeout_source_flag, entity_state_ext, tenant_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{entityTypeFlag}, #{entityId}, #{parentEntityId}, #{stateFlag}, #{initialLastStateFlag}, 1, #{expireTime}, #{timeoutSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 0, #{timeoutSourceFlag}, JSON_OBJECT('type', #{stateExtType}, 'content', COALESCE(#{stateDescription}, ''), 'version', 1), #{tenantId}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_entity_id = new.parent_entity_id,
last_state_flag = dc3_entity_state.entity_state_flag, entity_state_flag = new.entity_state_flag, lease_version = dc3_entity_state.lease_version + 1, expire_time = new.expire_time, timeout_seconds = new.timeout_seconds, last_heartbeat_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), timeout_source_flag = new.timeout_source_flag, entity_state_ext = CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{stateDescription}, '') != '' THEN JSON_OBJECT( 'type', JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dc3_entity_state.entity_state_ext, '$.type')), 'content', #{stateDescription}, 'version', COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dc3_entity_state.entity_state_ext, '$.version')) AS SIGNED), 0) + 1 ) ELSE dc3_entity_state.entity_state_ext END, operate_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
